navbar.twoFactorIntro: Add an extra layer of security: once enabled, every sign-in also requires a 6-digit code from Google Authenticator / Microsoft Authenticator.
navbar.twoFactorScan: Scan the QR code with your Authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows to confirm.
navbar.twoFactorDisableIntro: Two-factor authentication is on. To turn it off, enter your current password and a 6-digit code from your Authenticator app.
